_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Jupiter Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: CSB-hosted Edge/Edge+ T&C (PDF created 5 Sep 2026), Redemption Slabs: 1 Jewel = ₹0.20 when redeemed for Jupiter Flights, Jupiter Store, Brand Vouchers or Digital Gold; 1 Jewel = ₹0.14 for Statement Credit, Bill Payments or Cash/Cash-equivalent. Baseline uses the lower, cash-equivalent value. Jupiter or the bank may change the rates; the app shows the rate at redemption. Jewels do not expire except after 365 days of card inactivity or 90 days of unpaid dues.

open_questions: Earn only on the Jupiter UPI app: T&C 3a says the Edge+ RuPay card earns Jewels "only for transactions on the Jupiter UPI App" (UPI Intent, Scan and Pay, UPI Collect) and not on other UPI apps. The CSB page headline says 1% cashback on "all online & offline spends". The three rules are written for Jupiter UPI only; whether card swipe or online card spends earn anything needs a person.

Jewel value: ₹0.20 each for Jupiter Flights, Jupiter Store, Brand Vouchers and Digital Gold; ₹0.14 each for statement credit, bill payments and cash. Baseline uses ₹0.14 (0.7% on the 5-Jewel base rate). At ₹0.20 the T&C rates equal the page headline 10% shopping, 5% travel and 1% other.

Rates changed on 5 Oct 2026: the T&C lists the structure to 4 Oct 2026 (shopping 50% Jewels always, travel capped at 5,000 Jewels per cycle) and from 5 Oct 2026 (shopping 50% only when cycle spend is above ₹15,000, else 5%; travel uncapped). Only the current structure is modelled.

Shopping merchant cap 3,000 Jewels and transaction-level cap 1,000 Jewels per statement cycle are in the T&C; the schema has no per-transaction period, so the 1,000 sits in the rule conditions and only the 10,000 category cap and 3,000 merchant cap are cap rows. What earns after a cap is hit is not stated; downgrade to the 5-Jewel rate is assumed.
Joining fee: ₹999 + GST in the MITC and KFS; the CSB page says ₹499 for the first 2 lakh users. ₹999 is used.

Fuel surcharge waiver: 1% with a maximum of ₹100, on spends of ₹400 to ₹3,000 (MITC footnote); the period for the ₹100 maximum is not stated, so monthly_waiver_cap_inr is null. The page-level surcharge is ₹10 up to ₹400 and 1% above.

Insurance and concierge benefit (personal accident and total permanent disability up to ₹2 lakh, 24/7 concierge) is "limited to Platinum Variant Card (BIN 653038)"; whether Edge+ RuPay is that BIN is not stated, so it is not modelled.

The MITC covers three cards (Edge CSB RuPay joining nil; Edge+ CSB RuPay ₹999; Edge+ CSB Mastercard ₹999 with nil forex). This draft is the Edge+ RuPay card only. The non-plus Edge card (flat 2% Jewels, ₹250 welcome voucher) is a separate product not in the catalogue.
Rounding mode and the Jewel crediting delay are not stated. Minimum redemption threshold is shown in the Jupiter app, not in the documents.
notes: Card replacement ₹249. Interest 3.75% a month (45% a year), interest-free period 13 to 47 days. EMI processing ₹99 or 1% of the converted amount, whichever is higher; foreclosure 3% of remaining principal. Overlimit transactions are not allowed. Jewels earned in a cycle are locked and earning pauses while the minimum amount due is unpaid.
Held in the earlier pass for lack of a reward rate; the rates are now stated in the CSB-hosted T&C, so the card can be imported once the open questions above are cleared.
